purpose: Content-based discovery of refs that carry K1/K2/K3/K4/K5/P5Y/SR-K5 state. Refs are never selected by name.
carrier_regex_ere: P5Y_STATE|p5y_state|k1_successor_verdict|K1_SUCCESSOR|K4R1_SUCCESSOR_VERDICT|K4_SCIENTIFIC_LINE|K4_FINAL_VERDICT|independent_countersignature|K5_STATUS [(]CUSUM[)]|[|] SR K5 [|]|SR K5|SR_K5|K5_SR|SR-side K5|SR half of K5|K5_DECLARED_CLOSED|P5Y_DECLARED_CLOSED|K1_DECLARED_CLOSED|P5Y_STATUS|"P5Y": *"|"K[1-5]": *"|K[1-5] = [A-Z_]{4,}|P5Y = [A-Z_]{4,}|P5Y state|K5_COVERAGE_COMPLETE|coverage-map[.]v[0-9]|LEVEL4_GLOBAL_CLOSURE

state_mapping.K1: CLOSED iff K1_OWNER.scientific_verdict.k1_successor_verdict == K1_SUCCESSOR_CLOSED and residual_blockers == NONE; else the recorded token
state_mapping.SR_K1: CLOSED iff K1_OWNER.scientific_verdict.sr_successor_science == PASS and K1 is CLOSED; else the recorded token
state_mapping.K4: CLOSED iff K4_OWNER.K4R1_SUCCESSOR_VERDICT == CLOSED and K4_RESIDUAL_BLOCKERS == NONE and K4_OWNER.HISTORICAL_K4_COMMIT is the commit that introduced the K4_HISTORICAL record; else the recorded token
state_mapping.P5Y_SUMMARY: the P5Y summary (K1..K5, P5Y) of the live owner record whose introducing commit is newest; it must agree with K1, K2, K3 and K4 above (CLOSED <-> CLOSED or CLOSED_BY_LATER_SUCCESSOR_CAMPAIGN), otherwise CONFLICT
state_mapping.SR_K5: the state token of the '| SR K5 |' row of SRK5_OWNER (text before the first ':')

version_rule: for each owner-record path, collect the distinct blobs at all live commit tips; one blob -> current; several -> the version whose introducing commit is a descendant of every other version's introducing commit is current, the others superseded; otherwise CONFLICT
